data.text: LORD, God of vengeance, God of vengeance, shine forth!
data.titulo: A Cry to the Judge of the Earth

data.text: Rise up, Judge of the earth; repay the proud what they deserve.
How long will the wicked, LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
They pour out arrogant words; all evildoers boast.
They crush your people, LORD, and afflict your inheritance.
They kill the widow and the foreigner, and murder the fatherless.
They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob does not notice.”
Understand, you senseless among the people! Fools, when will you be wise?
Does the one who planted the ear not hear? Does the one who formed the eye not see?
Will the one who disciplines nations not correct, the one who teaches humanity knowledge?
The LORD knows human thoughts, that they are but a breath.
Blessed is the man you discipline, LORD, whom you teach from your law,
data.titulo: Blessed Is the One You Teach

data.text: to give him rest from days of trouble until a pit is dug for the wicked.
For the LORD will not reject his people or forsake his inheritance.
For judgment will return to righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against evildoers?
If the LORD had not been my help, my soul would soon have dwelt in silence.
When I say, “My foot is slipping,” your steadfast love, LORD, sustains me.
When anxious thoughts multiply within me, your consolations delight my soul.
Can a destructive throne be allied with you, one that fashions harm by statute?
data.titulo: A Destructive Throne and a Sure Refuge

data.text: They band together against the life of the righteous and condemn innocent blood.
But the LORD has become my stronghold, and my God the rock of my refuge.
He will bring their own wickedness back on them and destroy them for their evil; the LORD our God will destroy them.
